integrity: Self-contained elementary fiber proof with deterministic supplementary checker; previous linear-algebraic multi-tile methods are acknowledged. Publication priority and independent mathematical validation remain unperformed.
scientific_limitations: Only equal-length disjoint unit intervals and the two-coset frequency family; sharp squared Riesz-bound ratio, not globally best frequencies; no extension to unequal lengths, overlaps, or different supports.
title: Optimal two-coset Fourier conditioning on separated unit intervals
